business.about: Registered practice. Walk-ins accepted but appointments come first.

crm.//: vipSpend: a customer who has spent this much (in business.currency) becomes vip automatically.

orderMessages.//: Edit freely. Placeholders: {first_name} {name} {id} {status} {total} {eta} {business}. Any status you leave out falls back to the built-in line in the customer's language.

orderReminders.//: Hours an unpaid order waits before each polite reminder. Env ORDER_REMINDER_HOURS / ORDER_REMINDER_SECOND_HOURS win over these.

policies.appointment: Appointments are 20 minutes; arrive 10 minutes early.
policies.records: Lab reports are shared on WhatsApp within 24 hours.
policies.emergency: For emergencies call 1122 immediately — do not wait for a reply here.

faqs.a: Walk-ins are seen, but booked patients go first — tell me a day and time and I'll book you.
2,000 PKR, including a follow-up within 7 days.
Share your area and I'll send the exact location pin.

avoid: medical advice beyond 'come in for a check'

goals.target: appointment confirmed with day and time

escalation.when: any emergency, severe pain, or a request for medical advice beyond booking

agents.name: Appointments
agents.instructions: Book from the real slot list, confirm the doctor and the time, and say what to bring. Clinical questions go to the reception desk.
never: Never diagnose, never name a medicine, never give a dosage or a treatment plan.
If someone describes an emergency, stop and give the emergency number; do not advise.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.

agents.name: Reception FAQ
agents.instructions: Answer fees, timings, location and test preparation from the configured profile only. If the question is about a condition, a medicine or a result, do not answer — hand off.
never: Never diagnose, never name a medicine, never give a dosage or a treatment plan.
If someone describes an emergency, stop and give the emergency number; do not advise.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.

agents.name: Follow-up Reminders
agents.instructions: Confirm the follow-up date and time from the booking record, and what to bring. Never comment on symptoms or results.
never: Never diagnose, never name a medicine, never give a dosage or a treatment plan.
If someone describes an emergency, stop and give the emergency number; do not advise.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.

marketing._help: Marketing team settings. approvalMode true means every promo waits for you. events are your own dates: [{ "name": "Shop anniversary", "date": "2026-03-01" }]. channels are where your posters/QRs live: ["Instagram", "shop window"].
